caption: The drawing depicts a pair of metal tongs, likely silver, shown in a three-dimensional view with both arms curving upward and ending in rounded, spoon-like tips. The arms of the tongs have an engraved or cut-out decorative pattern running along their outer edges, and there is a small rectangular mark or stamp visible on the inner side of one arm. Below the tongs and to the right, there is an oval-shaped close-up illustration of the top part of one tong arm, featuring an engraved monogram consisting of the intertwined letters "MB," surrounded by a decorative border of leaves. The entire composition is centered on a lightly shaded cream or off-white background and is enclosed within a faint rectangular border. The drawing is executed in black and grey pencil or ink, with shading to indicate texture and dimensionality.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
